learner_operation: Translate incoming concentration and both flow rates into Q' = c*r_in - r_out*Q/(V0+(r_in-r_out)*t); solve with Q(0)=Q0, compute t_o=(capacity-V0)/(r_in-r_out), evaluate and round mass, then select among five nearby numerical masses.

fixed_features.justification: The KP is explicitly Determining an Amount at an Overflow Point; varying to a fixed unrelated time removes its extra operation.

fixed_features.feature: Inflow greater than outflow; positive capacity headroom
fixed_features.justification: Necessary for the stated filling-to-overflow scenario.
Observed easy method uses a quadratic integrating factor; retaining 2 is defensible for elementary workload, nearby small integral exponents need independent scope assessment.
